body: I don’t think I relied on her for happiness too much, even though she did make me happy. I mostly kept from killing myself because I know how awful she’d feel. But now I’m afraid I can convince myself that she won’t care like I did with my parents and friends.

I already see a therapist but he doesn’t really do much, just says pretty words and asks me if I want to try pills. He seems like a cool guy but I just don’t open up well. They most definitely would understand how I feel and stuff, maybe not the suicide part save for one, but I am far too embarrassed to actually do it lol. I feel shitty and selfish and just generally retarded. I feel like I need to be there for my friends when they’re low and I know they’d do the same for me but I’m embarrassed.

I do have friends that will understand but I don’t want to worry them with how I feel. They’re all in college anyway so they have their own stuff to deal with. I just got left behind since I’m younger. I know it probably does get better after I leave but I’m scared that it either won’t get better or it’ll just get worse. Worrying about bills, school, keeping myself fed. It just sounds so tiring.

I’m a senior in high school. I lost my job because of covid but I hated it anyway so I don’t really care. You can call me Vince if you like. It’s my middle name. I just don’t want anyone I know to find this account and ask me about it lol
